recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No source follow-up is needed for FHIR-17065 unless a future work group decision changes Patient $match scoring or the generated Patient Match page target.
issue_request: FHIR-17065 was a Published FHIR-core/FHIR-core-Feed change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking to add a link from Bundle.entry.search.score to the Patient resource's EMPI/Patient Match material as an example use case. The resolution was to add the example link while noting it was far from the primary search.score use.
initial_application: The change was applied in SVN revision 14372, preserved in Git as f27796fc5daa0699b7a6b603d8eebc07a6a77f00, which added the Patient Match link to the Bundle spreadsheet comment for Bundle.entry.search.score. Later source conversions from the spreadsheet to structuredefinition-Bundle.xml retained the same link and wording.
additional_context: Bundle is an active resource in source/fhir.ini, so source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml feeds the current build. The current Patient $match operation remains an active Patient artifact and still describes an MPI response as a searchset Bundle with patient records ordered by likely match and search scores from 0 to 1; a later FHIR-39400 change clarified the return Bundle type as searchset without undermining the FHIR-17065 link. FHIR-I minutes for 2018-07-09 list tracker 17065 as Persuasive with Modification, and community searches found no conflicting later decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was needed because the active Bundle StructureDefinition already contains: "See [Patient Match](patient-operation-match.html) for the EMPI search which relates to this element," satisfying the request on the generated Bundle definitions surface.

related_jiras.note: Earlier Published typo correction touched the adjacent Bundle search.score note and Search Relevance link but did not affect the Patient Match example link requested by FHIR-17065.
Later Published Patient Match clarification made the $match return Bundle explicitly a searchset, supporting that the Patient Match link target remains appropriate for search.score.
